Thanks, Yuriko! I would really appreciate your help with identifying those expenses. The online store is still in the early stages, but I'm excited about what it could become. Do you have any advice on how to effectively market it once it's up and running?

Absolutely! Once your online store is live, using social media marketing can be a great way to reach more customers. You might also consider email marketing to keep your existing customers informed about new products and promotions. If you’d like, I can share some resources that outline effective strategies for online marketing.

How does that sound?

That sounds perfect, Yuriko! I appreciate your support and guidance. Let's definitely set up a time to go over everything once I have the online store ready. I’ll keep you posted on the progress, and I’m looking forward to your resources!

Sounds great, Carmen! I'm excited to see how your online store develops. Just let me know when you're ready to meet, and we can dive into all those marketing strategies. In the meantime, if you have any other questions about taxes or e-commerce, feel free to reach out!
Thanks so much, Yuriko! I'll definitely reach out if I have any questions. I really appreciate your help. Also, if you ever need anything from the store, just let me know!
Thank you, Carmen! I really appreciate it. I'll definitely let you know if I need anything. Good luck with everything, and I can't wait to hear about the progress on the online store!
Thanks again, Yuriko! I'm really excited about the online store and can't wait to get your insights. Let's catch up soon!

Absolutely, Carmen! I'm really looking forward to helping you with the online store. Just let me know whenever you're ready, and we can set up a time to meet. In the meantime, feel free to reach out if you need any immediate assistance with anything else!
Thanks, Yuriko! I will definitely keep in touch as I make progress. I’ll be sure to reach out if anything comes up or if I have more questions. Have a great day!
